name: evaluator-optimizer
context: Tightly coupled generate-and-evaluate loop between two LLM roles: one produces output, the other scores it against clear criteria and returns actionable feedback until convergence.
benefits: Roles can differ in model strength
Natural fit for translation and writing refinement
tradeoffs: Doubles inference on the verified subset
anti_patterns: Same model/prompt family for both roles colludes on bad outputs (self-ratification)
Plateau guard missing - infinite loops on unresolvable feedback
design_principles: Use smallest capable model for evaluation (cost optimization)
Make each criterion binary (pass/fail), not numeric (1-10), for unambiguous targets
best_practices: Put the rubric in the evaluator prompt
Calibrate evaluator against human experts targeting 0.80+ Spearman correlation
Cap iterations at 3-5 rounds; most tasks plateau within 2-3
Run evaluator without seeing generator's reasoning trace to prevent priming
references: Wu et al., AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation, 2023 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.08155
